quickref.name: Frozen Pundra
quickref.era: BBG v2.7. Wiki dates it January 23, 2014 [Fan-wiki]; the official video is titled "BATTLE BEARS GOLD Update 2.7 "Frozen Pundra" Map Preview" [Canon]. Steam Yard Blues followed in 2.8 on March 4, 2014. No removal or rework is recorded.
quickref.in_2026: Probably returns but is not confirmed. Steam copy does not name it. SkyVu's 2026 short "BBG Maps Ranked part 1" shows it in a 16-map grid and in the "13-16" tier row [Observed]. 15 legacy maps plus Sky World make 16 [Inference]. The final playtest lists "Lighting improvements" [Canon].
quickref.setting: A fully enclosed ice cave, snow-covered almost throughout, with an icicle-fringed ice ceiling and no sky [Fan-wiki + Observed]. No story location is documented. The name is likely a 'tundra' pun [Inference].
quickref.palette_and_lighting: Bright, cool, candy-blue ice cave lit by flat ambient light with no visible source and no hard shadows. Snow is sky-cyan #71AEF4 to #92E1FB; ice ceiling is periwinkle #6E96EB with cyan #52A1DF; cave rock is deep indigo #1A2A5A; the dome rock is slate #293255; some areas have a lavender-pink tint #8D7890 [Observed]. The 2026 tile reads more mauve, with a plum rock block #292537 [Observed]. No falling snow was seen.
quickref.landmarks: A snow-capped dark rock dome at the centre, with a ground-level archway and jump pads. A raised snow-topped ring track on rock arches circling the dome. An icicle-fringed ceiling with big pale icicles. Hourglass stalactite-stalagmite ice columns and glassy ice masses. Tall snow mounds. A small snowman outside the track [Fan-wiki + Observed].
quickref.hazards_and_easter_eggs: Large lightly coloured icicles fall when shot. They take several seconds to drop, do little damage over a small area, and disappear on hitting the floor [Fan-wiki]. A jump pad under the dome leads to the Bearscream Sandwich near the dome roof [Fan-wiki]. The cramped layout snags Turkish SW Boots users [Fan-wiki]. The snowman outside the track is the documented easter egg [Fan-wiki]. The map has its own BGM; fan uploads attribute it to SkyVu [Unverified].

corrections.evidence: The Steam News API for app 4408320 has an Aug 19, 2026 post "3rd Discord Playtest this Friday! A New Map comes to BBG!" listing "New Map: Sky World". The teaser frame says "NEW MAP!" in the singular. The official short "BBG Maps Ranked part 1" shows 16 map tiles, which fits 15 legacy maps plus one new map.

corrections.correction: Addition: frames of this official short show a 4x4 grid of 16 map tiles, including Frozen Pundra, and a tier list with rows 1-4, 5-8, 9-12 and 13-16 in which the Frozen Pundra tile sits in 13-16. This is the best current evidence that Frozen Pundra is in the 2026 roster; SkyVu text does not confirm it.
